-- Notes: free-text notes the owner writes on a target (currently a project). A note belongs to one
-- target (target_type + target_id) and is stamped with when it was written so the newest shows
-- first. Additive: a new versioned migration.
CREATE TABLE notes (
    id          BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    target_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    target_id   BIGINT NOT NULL,
    body        VARCHAR(2000) NOT NULL,
    created_at  TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

The implementation is complete and the test passes. Here's a summary of the full-stack change I made to add notes to invoices (mirroring the existing job/project notes):

**Database** (`src/main/resources/db/migration/`)
- `V32__notes_target_index.sql` — additive index on `notes(target_type, target_id)`. The existing `notes` table was already polymorphic (`target_type`/`target_id`), so no shape change was needed — invoice notes use `target_type = 'invoice'`.

**Server** (`src/main/java/.../` + `officefloor/rest/api/invoices/`)
- `NoteRepository` — added `findByInvoice(...)` and `createForInvoice(...)` (newest-first, matching the project variants).
- `NewInvoiceNote` — request body (`invoiceId` + `text`).
- `InvoiceNotesGetLogic` + `notes.GET.yml` → `GET /api/invoices/notes?invoiceId=`.
- `InvoiceNotesPostLogic` + `notes.POST.yml` → `POST /api/invoices/notes`, returns notes newest-first.
- `TestSupportController.seedNotes` — the spec's fixture supplies a date-only `at: '2026-02-01'`; the seed path (app code that evolves with the schema) now accepts both plain dates and full offset date-times. No new seed method was needed since notes seeding is already polymorphic.

**Front-end** (`src/main/frontend/features/projects/`)
- `InvoiceNotes.tsx` — new component rendering `data-testid="invoice-notes"` with the shared `note-form-text`/`note-form-submit`/`note-row-{id}`/`note-text` anchors the spec expects; composed into `InvoiceDetail`.
- `ProjectInvoices` / `ProjectsPage` — opening an invoice now signals the page to step the project-level sections aside (drill-down focus), so there's a single notes form on screen. Added a "Back to invoices" control to restore them.

Verified with `bin/e2e`: **1 passed**. No pinned scaffolding or the test spec were touched.
